text: O you who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and acted upon His law, persist in what you are upon of firm belief in Allah Almighty, His Messenger Muhammad (peace be upon him), obedience to them, the Qur'an He revealed to him, and all the books Allah revealed to the messengers. And whoever disbelieves in Allah Almighty, His honored angels, His books revealed for the guidance of His creation, His messengers He chose to convey His message, and the Last Day when people will rise after their death for presentation and reckoning, has left the religion and strayed far from the path of truth.
